decisions.statement: A toggle name is written down in one place only.
The type of a set of toggles follows from that list rather than restating that list.
A character and a companion are automated by lists of their own.
A toggle a scope does not carry is absent rather than false.
Settings have a map for characters and a map for companions at every moment.
A toggle set for everyone lives under the global scope.
A character is keyed by its ESO character identity.
A companion is keyed by its companion identity.
A refusal lists the toggle names in the order the toggle names are written.

definition: every automation a character or a companion can have switched on
